name: Columbus Crew

name: Como
notes: Owned by Indonesia's Hartono brothers (Djarum) since 2019; heavy owner-funded spending; bankruptcies 2004 and 2017 with fan-backed refoundings; no discrimination or violence sanctions found.

name: Coventry City
notes: Local owner Doug King since 2023, bought the stadium back 2025; promoted to Premier League 2026; FA fine for a player mass confrontation (not fans); no fan sanctions found.

name: Crawley Town
notes: KB Sports and Leisure (Raphael Khalili, with US investor Ryan Gilbert) since Aug 2025 after US crypto group WAGMI United; ex-manager John Yems banned for racist abuse of his players (2022).

name: Crewe Alexandra
notes: Board-run local ownership (chairman Charles Grant); Sheldon Report (2021) said club should have done more over the Bennell abuse case; no fan sanctions found.

name: Crystal Palace
notes: Woody Johnson ~43%, Josh Harris and David Blitzer ~18% each, Steve Parish ~10%; sale explored 2026; Chexx Bet sleeve; FA fine for an offensive banner (2026) and UEFA fines for anti-UEFA banners, none for discrimination or violence.

name: D.C. United
notes: MLS franchise; Jason Levien and Steve Kaplan, who also hold Swansea City; 1998 CONCACAF Champions' Cup; no sanctions found. Accuracy pass 2026-10-12: multi_club flagship->none: Levien/Kaplan sold Swansea Nov 2024; Loudoun now Attain-majority, no network.

name: Deportivo La Coruña
notes: Abanca (Galician bank, Escotet) owns ~99% after converting debt; Riazor Blues are an anti-fascist group, a member killed in a 2014 brawl with Frente Atletico (outside the 5-year window).

name: Derby County
notes: Local developer David Clowes rescued club from administration 2022; 21-point deduction 2021-22 (administration and spending breaches); Saudi Lion Sport takeover withdrawn Aug 2026; Spreadex betting firm is a club partner (stadium branding, not shirt).

name: Derry City
notes: Funded by local chairman Philip O'Doherty, spending beyond income; crowd incidents: 2022 UEFA charges v CSKA Sofia, April 2024 missiles/flare and PSNI vehicles attacked v Shamrock Rovers (sanctioned); titles count 1965 Irish League plus 1989, 1997 LOI; cups count FAI, League of Ireland and Irish Cups.

name: Detroit City FC
notes: Founded by five residents; founders keep control, fans bought investment units (2020); openly anti-racist, inclusive fan culture; MotorCity Casino (with sportsbook) sleeve sponsor 2026-28; no sanctions found.

name: Doncaster Rovers
notes: Local owner Terry Bramall; earlier owner Ken Richardson convicted over arson at Belle Vue (1990s); CALM charity kit; no sanctions found.

name: Eintracht Frankfurt
notes: e.V. holds majority under 50+1; UEFA racism sanction (fan Nazi salute, Marseille 2022) and DFB fine for a queerphobic banner (2025); repeated UEFA fan-disorder sanctions and away bans (Marseille 2022, Naples 2023, Camp Nou 2025), 200+ hurt in 2023 Stuttgart clashes; ex-president barred AfD members.

name: El Paso Locomotive FC
notes: USL franchise of local MountainStar Sports Group; shares a baseball ground; no sanctions found.

name: Elche
notes: Owner Christian Bragarnik (Argentine player agent, 97%+) also controls Chilean clubs Union La Calera and San Luis; press reports of investigations into alleged funding of Argentine barras; kept charged player Rafa Mir until his 2026 conviction.

name: Espanyol
notes: Velocity Sports Partners (ALK Capital, Alan Pace; also owns Burnley) majority since Oct 2025; historic Brigadas Blanquiazules ultras had far-right links, no recent sanction found; RFEF partial closure for water thrown at a coach (2026).

name: Everton
notes: The Friedkin Group (94%) since Dec 2024, also owns AS Roma; two PSR points deductions 2023-24 under previous owner; Stake.com (forced out of GB market 2025) sleeve and stadium partner; no fan sanctions found 2021-26.

name: Exeter City
notes: Supporters' Trust holds 53.6% of voting shares since its 2003 rescue; no sanctions found.

name: FC Augsburg
notes: 50+1 applies but the pro company is investor-held via Hofmann Investoren: David Blitzer's Bolt Football Holdings ~45%, Klaus Hofmann ~30%; Blitzer has stakes in several clubs; no sanctions found.

name: FC Cincinnati
notes: Local Lindner family majority, Meg Whitman minority; USL club turned MLS franchise 2019; no sanctions found.

name: FC Dallas
notes: Hunt Sports Group (Hunt family, also Kansas City Chiefs); MLS founding franchise as Dallas Burn; stadium under renovation to 2028 (temporary capacity 11,004); no sanctions found.

name: FC Tulsa
notes: USL franchise, rebranded from Tulsa Roughnecks 2019; Craft family owners; plays in a baseball park; no sanctions found.

name: Fenerbahçe
notes: Members elect the president, club holds 62% of listed company; UEFA spending-rule fine (2026) and FIFA transfer ban; UEFA away-fan bans 2024 and 2026; 2011 match-fixing scandal; league titles counted as Super Lig era (19; club claims 28).

name: Feyenoord
notes: No single owner: association and foundations with supporter-investor group VAK; UEFA racism fine (monkey gestures, Barcelona 2026), prosecuted antisemitic chanting (2023); UEFA fines, away-fan ban and partial closure (2022), French travel bans.

name: Fiorentina
notes: Commisso family (US-based) since 2019, Rocco Commisso died Jan 2026; racist chants at Juventus players (Nov 2023, suspended closure); bet365 Scores brand on sleeve from 2026-27; Franchi under renovation with reduced capacity.

name: Fleetwood Town
notes: Owned by Jamie Pilley since 2024 after his father, former owner Andrew Pilley, was jailed 13 years for fraud (2023); no sanctions found.

name: Frosinone
notes: Local industrialist Maurizio Stirpe owns club and its stadium; founded 1906 as US Frusinate, club counts 1928; no sanctions found.

name: Fulham
notes: Shahid Khan (also Jacksonville Jaguars) owner since 2013; very high top-end ticket prices; no sanctions found.

name: Galatasaray
notes: Members elect the president, listed football company, debt-heavy spending; Misli (betting) shirt sponsor; firework thrown at Juventus (2026) injured two, UEFA away ban; 2023 UEFA fine at Man United; 2000 killings of Leeds fans outside window; league titles counted as Super Lig era.

name: Genoa
notes: Romanian businessman Dan Sucu majority since 2024 after 777 Partners' collapse, also owns Rapid Bucuresti (which club is the flagship is unclear); Genoa-Sampdoria ultras fought police before the Sept 2024 derby (38 hurt).

name: Getafe
notes: Angel Torres owner-president for 20+ years; racist abuse of Sevilla's Acuna (Mar 2024) brought RFEF fine, closure revoked on appeal; signed Mason Greenwood on loan 2023-24.

name: Gillingham
notes: US businessman Brad Galinson majority since Dec 2022; FA fine and action plan (2023) for race- and gender-related abuse at three 2022-23 matches, plus a lifetime ban after abuse of Omar Bogle.

name: Grimsby Town
notes: Local-born owners Jason Stockwood and Andrew Pettit (63%) with Mariners Trust 13.5%; suspended FA fine for sectarian chanting (2024).

name: Hamburger SV
notes: HSV e.V. holds ~75% of the AG, Kuhne Holding cut below 10%; Plan International charity sleeve; no sanctions found in research.

name: Hartford Athletic
notes: USL franchise of Hartford Sports Group; players refused to finish a 2025 match after alleging a racial slur against a teammate (league found it unsubstantiated).

name: Heart of Midlothian
notes: Foundation of Hearts holds 75%+ of voting shares since 2021 after fans' 2013 rescue; Tony Bloom (Brighton owner, betting fortune) holds 29% non-voting; no sanctions found. Accuracy pass 2026-10-12: multi_club secondary->none: Bloom's 29% is under 30%.

name: Hibernian
notes: US-based Gordon family (Bydand Sports) majority, bought back Bill Foley's 25% in Nov 2025; Hibernian Supporters Limited minority stake; fans' 1990 Hands off Hibs campaign; SBK betting sleeve.

name: Houston Dynamo FC
notes: MLS franchise moved from San Jose (2005); Ted Segal owns club and NWSL Houston Dash; no sanctions found.

name: Huddersfield Town
notes: California-based Kevin Nagle since 2023, also owns Sacramento Republic FC and a Sacramento Kings minority stake; no sanctions found. Accuracy pass 2026-10-12: multi_club flagship->none: Nagle is now a minority owner of Sacramento Republic (Wilton Rancheria majority), so he controls one club.

name: Hull City
notes: Turkish TV producer Acun Ilicali owner since 2022; FA fine (2026) for homophobic chanting v Chelsea, three fans banned.

name: Indy Eleven
notes: Ersal Ozdemir (Keystone Group); Eleven Park stadium plan stalled 2026; no sanctions found.

name: Inter Miami CF
notes: Jorge and Jose Mas with David Beckham, Ares Management $225m preferred equity; MLS $2m fine for salary-cap breaches (2021); captain Suarez banned for spitting (2025), Bright banned for a racial slur (2026).

name: Inter Milan
notes: Oaktree Capital ~99.6% since 2024 via loan enforcement; Betsson.sport shirt sponsor; Curva Nord leaders convicted after the 2024 killing of ultra Antonio Bellocco (mafia-linked); 2022 UEFA financial settlement; Super League signatory 2021, withdrew within days.

name: Ipswich Town
notes: Gamechanger 20: ORG (US pension-fund investment manager) ~45% and Bright Path Sports Partners (PE) ~40%; no sanctions found.

name: Juventus
notes: Exor (Agnelli-Elkann) ~65%, Tether 11.5%; plusvalenze 10-point deduction (2023), UEFA fines/settlements 2022-23; racist chants at Lukaku (2023, 171 fans banned); ultras brawl with Torino ultras (Nov 2024); Super League founder, left 2023-24.

name: LA Galaxy
notes: AEG (Philip Anschutz); MLS $100k fine and supporter privileges suspended for flares at 2024 El Trafico, fan brawl at San Diego 2025; club banned supporter-group members during 2025 ICE-raid protests.

name: LASK
notes: Friends of LASK, local entrepreneurs' consortium since 2013; 2020 12-point deduction for training during COVID ban (not financial); signed Jerome Boateng while his assault retrial was pending (2024).

name: Las Vegas Lights FC
notes: USL franchise; group led by Jose Bautista since 2024; no home ground secured for 2027; no sanctions found.

name: Lazio
notes: Claudio Lotito owner since 2004, mass fan boycott 2026; far-right Irriducibili legacy, UEFA/FIGC racism sanctions (2023 antisemitic chants, 2024 v Nice); ultras' knife ambush of Real Sociedad fans (2025), derby clashes 2025; transfer freeze over liquidity index (2025).

name: Le Havre

name: Le Mans

name: Lecce

name: Leeds United
notes: 49ers Enterprises 100% since 2023 (also holds a Rangers stake), Red Bull under 10%; FA GBP 150k fine for homophobic chanting (2023); BoyleSports official betting partner (not shirt) from 2026.

name: Leicester City

name: Lens

name: Levante

name: Lexington SC

name: Lille
